mentions.name: Pact
mentions.description: This app is a shared habit tracker where users commit to a habit, invite friends to join a pact, and keep each other accountable. Each day/week square fills up depending on how many members of the pact completed the habit, and streaks depend on everyone in the pact completing it.
mentions.problem: Sticking to good habits is hard without positive social pressure; the app provides accountability through friends keeping each other on track.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on my Pact app. A shared habit tracker. I need positive social pressure to stick to good habits. This helps me a lot.

You commit to a habit, invite your friends to join, and keep each other accountable.
